title: Share data on request under the Consumer Data Right (data holders)
what: Data holders in designated sectors (banking, energy, non-bank lending, telecommunications) must provide online services to share product and consumer data on request under the Consumer Data Right Rules.

laws.title: Competition and Consumer (Consumer Data Right) Rules 2020

sources.title: Competition and Consumer (Consumer Data Right) Rules 2020
sources.quote: 1.12 Product data request service (1) A data holder must provide an online service that: (a) can be used to make product data requests in relation to data that it holds; and (b) enables requested data to be disclosed in machine-readable form; and (c) conforms with the data standards.

reach.condition: if it is a data holder in a sector designated for the Consumer Data Right
